items.headline: Burch becomes 12th Buffalo player with 1,000 rushing yards in 28-7 win over Ball State
items.description: — Messiah Burch ran for a career-high 209 yards and two touchdowns and Buffalo defeated Ball State 28-7 on Wednesday night for their fifth straight victory.

items.headline: Wright accounts for 4TDs to send Buffalo past Miami (Ohio) 34-31 in OT
items.description: — Jason Wright threw for 358 yards and accounted for four touchdowns and Buffalo rallied in the fourth quarter to beat Miami of Ohio 34-31 in overtime on Tuesday night.
